businesses.business: natural gas compression rental and equipment

offering_description.value: Rents and sells natural gas compressor packages and provides installation, maintenance and parts to oil and gas producers and midstream operators. Equipment is deployed at well sites and gathering facilities across US oil and gas basins.

primary_products.value: natural gas compressor packages; compressor parts

primary_services.value: compression rental; maintenance and repair; aftermarket parts service

customer_segment.value: B2B: oil and gas producers, midstream gas gatherers and processors

end_markets.value: oil and gas production; midstream gas gathering and processing

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: monthly rental of compressor units to customers; product sales: sales of new compressor packages to customers; service fees: maintenance, repair and parts for compressor units
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates a rental fleet of compressors, sold to producers and midstream operators as rental service; OEM / manufacturer: fabricates compressor packages from purchased engines and components, sold to oil and gas operators; service provider: maintains and repairs compressors for customers, billed per service
value_chain_position.category: asset operator; OEM / manufacturer; service provider

geography_served.value: US national: Permian, Eagle Ford, Mid-Continent, Appalachia and other US oil and gas basins

specialization.value: niche specialist: natural gas compression equipment and related services only

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales and rental contracts with oil and gas producers and midstream operators; own locations: company service and fabrication facilities in several US locations

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: air emissions rules and pipeline and workplace safety rules, including EPA and OSHA requirements
